baseRevision.description: Use the latest confirmed revision from read or an applied edit result. Revisions increase on undo and redo too; never subtract from the revision.

preset.description: Update the visible preset ID and/or description. ID may change only before the preset is first saved (read.target.presetId is absent). Describe when squads should choose this workflow. Can accompany operations or documentJson, or be used alone. Cannot accompany historyAction. Workflow pages only; other page kinds never send this.

historyAction.description: Undo or redo one edit in the same history as the user buttons. Name and preset metadata are excluded. Read history.canUndo/canRedo first. Do not combine with operations or documentJson.

id.description: Unique step ID; outcomes and entry refer to it.

name.description: Display name; connections still use id.

instructions.description: What to do and how to judge the result.

output.description: The expected result or evidence; guidance, not a validated format.

returnTo.description: Step that performs the requested revisions, for example create-assets.

afterRework.description: Default: follow-graph runs the normal outgoing arrows after revisions. return-to-requester sends the corrected result straight back to the step requesting changes, bypassing the correction step’s forward arrows.

outcomes.description: 1–16 named outcomes, each with one transition.

participant.description: ID of an entry in the definition’s participants.

anyOf.description: A participant agent does the work and submits one of the outcomes with evidence.

operations.description: Preferred: an atomic list of targeted changes to read.document, using this page kind's own operation set (workflow customizations or theme operations — never mix kinds; the server rejects an operation from the wrong page kind).

documentJson.description: Alternative for a complete redesign: JSON.stringify of only read.document, never the read envelope. Do not include operations when using documentJson.
